doc.title: Jay McShann interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Future plans, reunion with Spoon and Fiddler, tonight's show and goodbye
summary: McShann will roll with the punches, enjoys the reunion, mentions reissues and tonight's blues show with Plas Johnson, and the interview closes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: What’s in store for you in the future from here?
Well I don’t know. I guess I’ll just roll with the punches, whatever happens you know, is. I guess that’s the way I explain it.
Well it’s nice to see you reunited with Spoon and the Fiddler.
You’ve had a marvelous career, and it’s been such a pleasure to talk to you.
It’s a pleasure being here, thank you.
Do you sometimes see re-issues come out of records that you’ve forgotten you made?
Yes that it true, yes. A lot of times like I say we’ve made stuff and we’ve forgotten about it. Yes that is true.
What’s on the agenda for tonight?

Well we’re going to do the blues tonight, let’s see I think we’ve got Spoon there, we’ve got Plas Johnson, you know Plas Johnson can play anything you know. It don’t make no difference what it is, he can play it, you know. I wish I had a feel like that you know. Yeah Plas can adapt. It doesn’t make any difference. It can be a swing tune, it can be a pop tune, it can be a ballad. He’s just ready for it you know.
Well on behalf of Hamilton College I’d like to thank you again for joining us, and it’s been a great pleasure.
Well thank you too and it’s been a pleasure. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -11-
